title: The Night Market
blurb: Your aunt has hurt her hand, so for one night the family's dumpling stall is yours — and you must take enough by dawn to keep the pitch she has held for thirty years.

identity.name: Lantern Night
identity.mood: A loud warm market in the dark; one stall's lantern is the light you keep.

line.en: One night, one stall, and a fee due by dawn.
line.fr: Une nuit, un étal, et une redevance à payer avant l'aube.
line.es: Una noche, un puesto y una cuota que pagar al amanecer.
line.it: Una notte, una bancarella e una quota da pagare all'alba.
line.de: Eine Nacht, ein Stand und eine Gebühr, fällig bis zum Morgengrauen.
line.pt: Uma noite, uma banca e uma taxa a pagar até ao amanhecer.
line.ru: Одна ночь, один прилавок и плата, которую нужно внести к рассвету.
line.zh: 一个夜晚，一个摊位，天亮前要交的摊位费。
line.ar: ليلة واحدة، وكشك واحد، ورسوم مستحقة قبل الفجر.

hero.sub: A story where you are the hero — and every choice turns you to a new page. Written for people learning English, at your level, with meaning in your language whenever you need it.
